def: llama.cpp's GGUF quantization types with names such as Q4_K_M, which store weights in super-blocks of 256 values with quantized per-block scales; S, M and L variants mix bit widths across tensors.
practice: Q4_K_M averages about 4.9 bits per weight on Llama 3.1 8B in llama.cpp's own table; an importance matrix computed on sample text reduces accuracy loss, and i-quants (IQ types) go lower.
